_comment: Claude Desktop MCP configuration for Mission 1 (MMS Midway 2026).
The hosted Sentinel MCP server is a remote HTTP server with OAuth. In
Claude Desktop and claude.ai you normally add it through Settings >
Connectors > Add custom connector rather than this file; the entries below
are for Claude Code and for clients that read a config file directly.
Auth is interactive: on first use the client opens the Entra consent
screen, you sign in as the demo analyst, and the token is scoped to that
user. Every tool call is then evaluated against that user's RBAC.
Do not put a client secret in this file. The app registration created by
Register-SentinelMcpApp.ps1 is a public client and does not have one.

sentinel-data-exploration._use: Mission 1 - natural-language investigation over the data lake

sentinel-triage._use: Mission 2 / Demo 3 - Defender incidents, alerts, evidence, entities, advanced hunting

sentinel-local-replay._use: Offline fallback. Serves the same tool names from sample data so the walkthrough runs with no tenant and no network.
